metadata.name: kitty
metadata.description: Kitty: private, protected savings parties on Solana

accounts.name: signer

accounts.name: signer
docs: The guest's party wallet (`pay_manual`) or any cranker (`collect`).

docs: The guest's token account (checked against the guest's wallet in the handler).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer (the relay); pays the marker's rent.

accounts.name: marker
docs: Its existence is the "one person, one pass" check.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The guest's party wallet for this party (bound into the proof's params hash).

accounts.name: wallet_token
docs: The wallet's token account; auto-pay is the party PDA as its SPL delegate.

accounts.name: winner_token
docs: Tonight's guest's token account (for a House seat: the removed guest's, for their refund).

accounts.name: host_token
docs: The host's token account; the same account as `winner_token` when the host takes the kitty.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The guest's party wallet for this party.

fields.name: paid_through
docs: Rounds now covered.

types.name: Config
docs: Program parameters (architecture 4.1). The admin can tune fees within caps and pause new
parties; nothing here can move a vault.

fields.name: mint
docs: The 6-decimal test token (kUSD) or devnet USDC.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Token account that receives the Kitty fee.

fields.name: min_grace_secs
docs: Shortest grace a party may use (devnet demo parties use minutes, not 72 hours).

fields.name: collect_window_secs
docs: How long after a round is due before it can be settled (the Butler collects in between).

fields.name: now_tolerance_secs
docs: Allowed gap between a proof's `now` and the Solana clock (T7).

fields.name: allowance
docs: Starter kitty limit (product doc 11.1).

fields.name: aadhaar_pubkey_hash
docs: Anon Aadhaar RSA public-key hash this deployment accepts (the test key on devnet).

fields.name: nullifier_seed
docs: Kitty's Anon Aadhaar nullifier seed (app id).

fields.name: dev_register
docs: Devnet only: the admin may register test identities without an Aadhaar proof (harness bots).

fields.name: invite_key
docs: Public half of the invite key; the invite link carries the secret in its fragment.

fields.name: removed
docs: A guest who had not taken the kitty is removed and the House Fund takes the seat.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 fee in, 1 cover out, 2 settle in, 3 late fee, 4 deposit, 5 withdraw, 6 seat payout, 7 reimbursed

fields.name: exposure
docs: Σ exposure of active parties.

types.name: KittyTree
docs: The Kitty tree: an append-only Poseidon Merkle tree of notes, receipts and completion leaves,
with the last 64 roots (architecture 4.1, 7.3).

fields.name: kind
docs: 1 note, 2 receipt, 3 completion

types.name: Marker
docs: Existence is the check (registration nullifiers and spent note nullifiers).

types.name: Member
docs: One guest, inside the party account. Guests are known only by their party tag.

fields.name: keepsafe
docs: Keepsafe still held for this guest (released with each later chip-in).

fields.name: keepsafe_total
docs: Keepsafe at the moment they took the kitty.

fields.name: remaining
docs: Remaining obligation R = c(N − s) when they took the kitty.

fields.name: vouched
docs: Plus-one stakes behind this guest, and how much of them the waterfall used.

fields.name: advance
docs: Chip-ins the House Fund fronted while this guest is in grace.

fields.name: debt
docs: What the House Fund covered after a default (repaid by settling up).

fields.name: house_paid
docs: Chip-ins the House Fund paid for a removed guest's seat.

fields.name: seat
docs: Earliest night this guest may take the kitty (Draw), or their night (seating plan).

fields.name: took_night
docs: The night they took the kitty, 0 if not yet.

fields.name: paid_through
docs: Rounds covered (by the guest, the waterfall or the House Fund for a removed seat).

fields.name: own_paid
docs: Rounds the guest paid themselves.

types.name: Party
docs: A party (architecture 4.1). Fixed size, zero-copy.

fields.name: exposure
docs: The House Fund cover this party adds while active.

fields.name: current_round
docs: Rounds settled so far.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 forming, 1 active, 2 finished, 3 cancelled

types.name: Proof
docs: A Groth16 proof in groth16-solana layout (A negated; G2 as c1‖c0).

fields.name: house_fronted
docs: Chip-ins the House Fund fronted for guests in grace (or paid for a removed seat).

types.name: VouchStake
docs: A plus-one stake behind one guest.
